amount.description: A price, cost, count, or other quantity the subject has now

date.description: When the subject happens, happened, or is due

detail.description: Another fact about the subject worth keeping

did.description: Something the subject did or that happened, with its date when known

dislikes.description: Something the subject dislikes or avoids

goal.description: Something the subject is working toward

likes.description: Something the subject likes, enjoys, or prefers

note.description: A statement worth keeping that no other predicate fits, in the words it was stated

owns.description: Something the subject owns or has

plans.description: Something the subject plans or intends to do

relationship.description: A person in the subject's life and how they are related, such as sister Emma

role.description: The subject's current job or role

status.description: The current state or progress of the subject, such as in repair or halfway through
